rationale: The material prompt requirement is Create page-ready narrative content for a proposed scripted or unscripted series. In 650–800 present-tense. At # Series Pitch Deck Writer, the source is scoped to "Writes the complete narrative content for a TV or streaming series pitch deck, covering logline, format overview, episode structure, tone, comparable shows, and target broadcaster rationale."; that source-visible scope directly supplies the required workflow and outputs without a material unsupported component.
